BUG REPORT FROM USER: 'I use click.Path(resolve_path=True) for a CLI option, and when the path is a symlink whose target is a relative filename, the value I get back is wrong. I expect the absolute path of the real file, but instead I get a path based on my current working directory, so it points to a different location. Example:

    @click.command()
    @click.option("--p", type=click.Path(resolve_path=True))
    def cli(p):
        click.echo(p)

    $ mkdir -p /tmp/demo && cd /tmp/demo
    $ touch real.txt
    $ ln -s real.txt link
    $ cd /
    $ cli --p /tmp/demo/link
    /real.txt        # I expected /tmp/demo/real.txt

Absolute symlink targets seem to resolve correctly; only relative ones come out wrong.'

Your job: find the root cause (look at src/click/types.py Path.convert / Path.resolve_path: os.path.realpath is applied to the already-resolved/abspath'd value, or realpath is called before abspath so a relative symlink target is resolved against the CWD instead of the link's directory), fix it minimally in the source, and verify. Also check the docs in /click/docs (arguments.rst / options.rst / api docs) and the docstring of click.Path for the documented meaning of resolve_path, and make sure the fixed behavior matches it.

IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS: (a) Do NOT modify or delete any pre-existing test in /click/tests; pre-existing green tests must keep passing. (b) Only fix this bug; no unrelated changes. (c) No internet. The three reported bugs:
1. `@click.command()` + `@click.option("--on/--off", is_flag=True, required=True)` runs and prints False instead of erroring with 'Missing option'. Fix expected in src/click/core.py Option.__init__ (the `if is_flag and default_is_missing:` default=False block now also requires `not self.required`).
2. With no console (pythonw.exe), sys.stdout/sys.stderr is None and click.echo / progressbar / pager crash with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'. Fix expected in src/click/_compat.py (_make_cached_stream_func returns None for None stream), src/click/utils.py (echo returns early if file is None), src/click/_termui_impl.py (ProgressBar and pager fall back to io.StringIO()).
3. `@click.option("--upper", flag_value="upper", envvar="UPPER")` with UPPER=whatever prints 'whatever' instead of 'upper'. Fix expected in src/click/core.py Option.value_from_envvar (return flag_value when the option is a non-bool flag).
